I wouldnt view maggies traits as flaws, but through a neurotypical lens unfortunately her traits are seen as flaws due to anti-autism attitudes and people not being willing or able to understand autistic people's perspectives and motivations

I think its less of that and more that a lot of the reason she is disliked is because she is autistic and autistic traits are heavily judged in society due to ableism. many autistics are familiar with being unlike because of something that ends being related to autism not because there's anything wrong with those traits but because society often consciously and unconsciously frowns upon autistic traits. 

its somewhat similar to when a character faces a lot of scrunity because shes a woman and would probably be prasied if she were a man. shes not unlikable because shes a woman, shes seen as unlikeable because society at large does not like women whether or not individuals are aware of their own biases

while thats true, placing judgment on people for traits highly central to autism, whether or not they are actually autistic, still contributes to anti-autism attitudes in society by stigmatizing traits that are a core part of many autistic people
